about_the_game:
Embark on a Dark Adventure Inspired by Dante and Lovecraft

Dive into the haunting depths of Soulkeeper, where classical myth collides with cosmic horror. Inspired by Dante's The Divine Comedy and Lovecraftian dread, this 8-bit adventure challenges you to save lost souls amidst pixel art landscapes and immersive gameplay.

In This Demo:

  • Face the First Boss – Confront a formidable guardian in the First Layer of Hell.

  • Explore Limbo – Experience the Clicker mechanic and gather coins and items to upgrade your Soul Seeker.

  • Soul Management – Strategically move platforms to rescue tormented spirits from lurking tentacles.

  • Unique Power-Ups – Unleash the power of Hell's Blazer and Sacred Burst to overcome challenges.

Will You Become the Guardian of Souls?
Test your courage in this challenging yet rewarding adventure. Will you conquer the First Layer of Hell and master the power of Limbo? Your journey to becoming the ultimate Soulkeeper begins now.
